generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: transparent dark-ink logo master for an independent car-dealer website proposal. Exact text: MICHAEL ANDREW, with CARS LTD as a second line at a meaningful readable size. Create ONE polished horizontal identity. At left use a tailored original MA ligature: two bold upright stems and a simple peaked central negative space, clear at favicon scale. At right elegant, precisely spaced modern sans-serif uppercase wordmark; confident, uncluttered, high-quality independent dealership identity. Dark charcoal/black solid ink only, crisp flat vector-style geometry. No car drawing, speed swoosh, shield, circle enclosure, manufacturer emblem, gradient, metallic effect, fine hairlines, texture, shadow, tagline, watermark or background rectangle. True alpha-transparent background, never a fake checkerboard. Wide landscape canvas tightly but comfortably framed at approximately 5% transparent outer margin; symbol and full exact name should occupy most available area. One logo only, no presentation board.

Create the clean matching light-ink version of the supplied logo for dark website headers. Exact text MICHAEL ANDREW / CARS LTD; slash means an existing line break, do not add a slash character. Preserve the existing symbol, typography, text line positions, spacing and overall shape closely. Foreground must be clean smooth solid pure white with normal anti-aliased edges. All letter interiors are solid smooth ink; absolutely no distress, grain, scratch marks, cutout fragments, holes, stippling, texture or black outline. Genuine alpha-transparent background with open counters, no backdrop or checkerboard. No gradients, lighting, shadow, extra text, border or mockup. One polished white horizontal logo only, use the reference identity. Keep a wide landscape composition with roughly 5% transparent padding.
